summary: This Form 6-K by Ascendis Pharma A/S reports Week 182 Phase 3 PaTHway Trial data for TransCon PTH in hypoparathyroidism. The filing discloses long-term efficacy and safety results, including responder rates, biomarker improvements, and quality-of-life measures. No corporate transaction, capital event, or structural change is involved. It is a routine clinical-trial update for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, advisors, board recommendations, or regulatory clocks are present. The filing does not constitute a special situation under event-driven categories.
